footer.tagline: Modula — React Project Scaffolder & WDS Design System.

landing.badge: React 19 • Vite 8 • Tailwind CSS 4 • WDS Design System
landing.title: Build production-ready React projects in minutes
landing.subtitle: Configure your project through an interactive installer wizard: plug-and-play authentication, built-in User & Role management, example flat & parent-child CRUD modules, WDS shared components, and an embedded module generator for future development.
landing.highlightsTitle: Everything included in your generated basecode
landing.highlightsSubtitle: No external UI lock-in — components are copied into src/shared/components and ready to customize.

cards.authDesc: Pick the exact auth flows you need via checkboxes: Login, Logout, Forgot & Reset Password, Registration, and 6-digit Two-Factor Authentication.
cards.modulesDesc: Ships with User & Role CRUD (including permission matrix, Excel bulk upload & export) plus a single module and a parent-child pair of generic example modules.
cards.generatorDesc: Your downloaded project includes the visual /generator wizard and Vite dev writer plugin so your team can scaffold new modules anytime during development.
cards.dsDesc: 50+ accessible WDS components (Button, InputField, Select, DatePicker, Table, FormArrayField, and more) in src/shared/components with light/dark theme tokens.

workflowSteps.s1Desc: Set the project name, upload your logo and choose what shows when the sidebar is collapsed.
workflowSteps.s2Desc: Pick the default theme and primary color.
workflowSteps.s3Desc: Toggle auth flows, User & Role management and the example modules.
workflowSteps.s4Desc: Get a clean, self-contained React + TypeScript repository with embedded /generator ready for npm install && npm run dev.

wizard.title: Create New React Project
wizard.subtitle: Follow the installation steps below to customize and download your project basecode.

projectStep.title: Step 1 — Project Name & Brand
projectStep.desc: Enter your application name and upload your brand logo. The npm package slug is generated automatically.

stackItems.ui: UI Components: src/shared/components (WDS Design System copied directly, no external UI library needed)
stackItems.data: Data Layer: Mock-first with api/resolver.ts (USE_MOCK toggle ready to switch to Axios backend)
stackItems.routing: Routing & Guards: React Router 7 + RequireAuth + PermissionGate + i18next (EN & ID)
stackItems.generator: Embedded Tooling: Visual Module Generator (/generator) + Vite dev file-writer plugin

projectStep.logoSupporting: SVG, PNG, JPG or WebP · max 512 KB. Shown on the brand-colored sidebar header and used as the favicon when it is an SVG.
projectStep.collapsedInitial: Use the first letter of the project name
projectStep.collapsedSupporting: Square works best (for example 64×64). SVG, PNG, JPG or WebP · max 512 KB.
projectStep.errorType: Unsupported file. Use SVG, PNG, JPG or WebP.

authStep.title: Step 3 — Plug & Play Authentication Features
authStep.desc: Select the authentication capabilities to include in src/modules/auth/. Selected routes, links, and locales are wired automatically.

modulesStep.title: Step 4 — Default & Example Modules
modulesStep.desc: User & Role modules and sample flat / parent-child CRUD modules are enabled by default. You can toggle any of them below.
modulesStep.coreGroup: Default Access Management Modules (Parent-Child: User Management)
modulesStep.exampleGroup: Example CRUD Modules (Single & Parent-Child, generic names you can rename)

reviewStep.title: Step 5 — Review & Download Basecode
reviewStep.desc: Verify your setup below and click Download Basecode (.zip) to build your project in the browser.
reviewStep.generatorNote: Included at /generator (with Vite dev writer plugin for generating new modules into src/modules/).
reviewStep.successMsg: Successfully built {{fileName}} ({{count}} files). Check your browser downloads!

themeStep.title: Step 2 — Theme
themeStep.desc: Choose the default mode and primary color. Users of the generated app can still change both from the theme switcher.
